'''Hologram watches''' were devices used among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to communicate with the [[Sith Master/Legends|masters]] of their sect. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] kept one in his collection of Sith objects.<ref name="BTS" />
